teaching_point: Extensive papules/plaques — potent topical steroid short course; refer if severe/recurrent for phototesting/desensitisation.

teaching_point: 'Polymorphic' — targetoid morphology can mimic erythema multiforme; check ANA/Ro if atypical (exclude SCLE).

teaching_point: Port-wine / dark urine — ask about it; screen liver (LFT, ferritin/HFE, hep C, HIV).

teaching_point: Phototoxic — exaggerated sunburn within hours; doxycycline is the commonest UK primary-care culprit.

teaching_point: Sharp limitation to exposed skin, sparing finger sides — phototoxic pattern (burning > itch).

teaching_point: Sparing under watch strap — ask about every new drug in last weeks–months.
dermnet_caption: Thiazide photosensitivity - note the sparing under the watch strap

teaching_point: Amiodarone — phototoxicity (and slate-grey pigmentation); persists months after stopping — never stop without cardiology.

teaching_point: Eczematous, itchy pattern (photoallergic-type) — may spread beyond exposed sites.

teaching_point: Oral NSAID phototoxic eruption — also counsel on topical ketoprofen (photoallergy; avoid sun on treated area).

teaching_point: Lime juice + sun — bizarre/drip-shaped erythema ('margarita' dermatitis).

teaching_point: Linear streaks where sap/juice brushed skin — clue to exogenous cause (not immune).

teaching_point: Bullous phototoxic burn 24–48 h after contact + UVA; cool compresses, potent steroid, burn-style care.

teaching_point: Giant hogweed (UK riverbanks/verges) — severe blistering; wash sap off immediately, cover for 48 h.

teaching_point: Residual hyperpigmentation for months — reassure; strict sun protection. Atypical patterns in children: consider safeguarding DDx.
